name: YouTube comments sentiment to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## YouTube comments to Google Sheets for sentiment
Pull the comments from any public YouTube video(s) (top or newest), score each as positive / neutral / negative, write one row per comment to the *Comments* tab and a roll-up per video to the *Summary* tab. Commenter names and channel links are intentionally not stored.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Credentials > New > *Header Auth*. Name it `Apify API token`. Header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > Integrations).
2. Open the Google Sheets node(s), connect Google Sheets OAuth2, and replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID` (and the tab name if needed). Create two tabs: `Comments` and `Summary`.
3. Edit `startUrls` (videos, Shorts, playlists or channels) and `maxComments` in *Run Apify actor*.
4. Click *Execute workflow* to test with the small sample input, then activate.

Runs the Apify actor https://apify.com/transparent_meteorite/youtube-comments-scraper (pay-per-result; the free Apify plan credit covers a trial). Maintained by the author of the actor.

parameters.errorMessage: Apify run failed for youtube-comments-scraper. Check the token credential, plan credit and input JSON.
